findings.text: The only controller code changes are the pure binding preflight, validation of already-held append receipt/arm lineage, and exact positive binding-file whitelist. All six scheduler/stage/case/finalizer modules are byte-identical to accepted prospective-timing-v3. Recovery control changes only ledger pin, empty default queue, and positive_binding_files; original planning resolver/map remain unchanged.

All63 nonempty exact whole-pair subsets preserve declaration order, exact two arms/six jobs per pair, S8 identities, case_sources and full original planning closure. Empty, split, duplicate, aliased, foreign or partial queues/jobs reject. Twelve source declarations do not reserve resources or promise all six outcomes.

Exact accepted independent binder review and distinct root binder acceptance must bind this controller snapshot/control. Accepted root production release, unchanged route/native/account/model pins, exact old V7 lineage, positive source inventory, fixed start/global end and original component limits remain required.

Already-stored successful append receipt must match exact selected declaration pairs, closure/V7 pins, root authority and original caps; selected arm lineage and literal final-correction promises must match. Missing/tampered/refunded/over-cap receipts reject with held fixture state unchanged. Accepted API proof is reused unchanged; binder neither imports nor invokes it.

Whole-V7 quiet record requires exact predecessor pin, finite campaign-bounded observation time and literal true scheduler/native/parents/actors/permits assertions. Missing, wrong, future, before-start, boolean or aliased metadata rejects; quiet is never inferred from absent ledger rows.

No fresh binding resets original births, old spent/future commitments, output thresholds/unknown usage, two Z slots, GLM5.3FlashMax/original opaque account,144 starts/172800 occupied seconds or original global deadline. Inherited accounting/admission still governs every actual stage.

source_only_limitations: This acceptance covers frozen source/metadata compatibility and auth-free fixtures only. No installation, append action, live ledger read/transaction, current subset feasibility or native qualification was performed.

Quiet validation proves metadata structure, exact pins and campaign-bounded timestamps, not genuine external/current quiet. Root must positively observe held scheduler/native/parent/actor/cgroup/permit settlement and retain actual evidence under serialization through one fresh launch. A historical campaign timestamp or metadata flag alone is insufficient operational evidence.
No binder lock prevents a second uncoordinated root launch; root campaign serialization remains mandatory.

Receipt aggregate nonnegativity, actual old-commitment retention and resource arithmetic are guarantees of the unchanged accepted API and stored successful transaction, whose41-test independent proof was reused. Mock receipt checks do not establish actual ledger state.

Inherited route/SDK/runtime/auth pins are copied/compared as metadata only; common release fixtures mock route digests and held state. No private SDK/auth contents or real native/provider calls were used.

All12 declarations remain source-only. Root must choose a currently resource-fitting nonempty wholepair subset and separately perform the already accepted append API; rejected append remains HOLD without retirement/refund/reset.
